question: Manav starts from point A and drives 10 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 12 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 13 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Manav starts from point A and drives 10 km towards the east.

He then takes a right turn, drives 9 km, turns right and drives 12 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 13 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at point P.
